# Franco Ortiz

## About
Franco Ortiz is a Technical Product Manager based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He runs product for the cross-border payments squad at belo (belo.app), a LatAm fintech with 3.5M+ users, after four years leading its frontend and mobile engineering. On the side he builds i1n (i1n.ai), a localization tool for React and React Native.

## Current role
- Technical Product Manager at belo (Feb 2026 - Present): roadmap and OKRs for cross-border payments; payment-provider integrations in new countries; planning for squads without a tech lead; own analysis in SQL. His OKR format became the company standard.

## Previous roles
- Frontend & Mobile Lead at belo (Feb 2022 - Feb 2026): led the rewrite of the app from Flutter to React Native (3.5M users, five months); built and managed the frontend and mobile teams.
- Frontend Developer at Navent (May 2021 - Jan 2022): Zonaprop and Imovelweb, React.
- Frontend Developer at Aconpy (Feb 2021 - May 2021): Paiddly virtual wallet.

## Side project
- i1n (https://i1n.ai): localization infrastructure for React and React Native stacks; landing, dashboard and npm CLI.

## Skills
- Product: Product Management, Technical Product Management, Payments, Cross-border Payments, OKRs, Roadmaps, Vendor Management, SQL / BigQuery
- Engineering: React Native, React, TypeScript, Mobile Architecture, Engineering Management, AI agents in the development workflow
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (professional working proficiency)
